name: Historical Climate Data of Canada
description: Historical Climate Data of Canada is the official national archive of land-based weather observations collected across Canada by Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC). Spanning hourly, daily, and monthly temporal scales across several thousand monitoring stations, the archive contains records dating back to 1840 for elements including temperature, precipitation, wind speed, relative humidity, atmospheric pressure, and visibility. The data are provided in downloadable CSV format and via the MSC Datamart under the Open Government Licence - Canada.
